- **Charcoal_Rot**: Eliminated — shows a charcoal-gray/dark uniform discoloration of the stem, not discrete tiny specks on a light stem.
- **Anthracnose**: Eliminated — shows dark blotchy lesions and spines on darker tissue, not the scattered dot pattern seen here.

The microscopic close-up clearly reveals pycnidia in linear rows on a pale stem — the hallmark diagnostic sign of Diaporthe (pod and stem blight).
